# @lowerdeck/cache

> 标签: JavaScript

## 简介

Multi-layer caching with Redis and in-memory LRU cache. Supports tag-based invalidation, dynamic TTL, and local-only caching for optimal performance.

- npm 页面：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lowerdeck/cache
